about: Whitecourt is a town in west-central Alberta where the McLeod and Athabasca rivers meet, on the Highway 43 corridor northwest of Edmonton. Forestry, oil and gas, and trail recreation in the surrounding boreal mixed-wood define this northern service town. About 10,000 people live in Whitecourt.
